pilot.projection_basis: previous 20 n=6/n=8 profile-seed checkpoints plus n=4/6/8 R3 references

scope.b1: one row per profile,n; source checkpoint seeds 0-4 were identical; n_unique_fits=1; no interval
scope.b2: one row per profile,n,L,rung; source checkpoint seeds 0-4 were identical; n_unique_fits=1; no interval
scope.b2_rung3_subset_sweep: 200 subset seeds per profile,n,L, paired with rung 2; L=n is full-set deterministic
scope.oracle_label: exact target coefficient access is oracle
scope.r3: memorizer, uniform sprayer, known-support, and ceiling references at registered N grid; no model comparison
scope.target_role: train histogram used by each frozen checkpoint
